about_the_game:
Explore Rockle National Park with up to 3 of your photojournalist friends. Take jobs from top magazine brands, and then hit the trail in search of interesting landmarks and goofy creatures to photograph. Use your pay to buy useful items and cosmetics. You’ll be sure to make the front page in a flash!

COOPERATIVE MULTIPLAYER

Explore Rockle National Park with up to 3 of your friends! Work together to complete jobs for top magazine brands or just smack your comrades upside the head with a hammer (sickle not included).

CUSTOMIZE YOUR CHARACTER

shutterbuds contains dozens(?) of funny and interesting cosmetic options for you to unlock and personalize your character with!

YOU HAVE A CAMERA AND CAN TAKE PICTURES

Armed with your trusty Rejec brand digital camera, you can take photos of anything you see. Also featuring a convenient ‘Save to Desktop’ button so you can share them more easily!

SILLY LITTLE GUYS

Rockle National Park is filled with a variety of unique creatures, all with their own behaviors and personalities!

MAKE THE FRONT PAGE IN A FLASH

As you complete more jobs, the magazines you work for will be filled out with your photos, eventually creating articles for you to read.
